description: NaErPO₄F crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/m space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four O and two equivalent F atoms. There are two shorter (2.50 Å) and two longer (2.63 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Both Na-F bond lengths are 2.46 Å. Er is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to six O and two equivalent F atoms. There are a spread of Er-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.44 Å. There is one shorter (2.26 Å) and one longer (2.28 Å) Er-F bond length. P is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (1.54 Å) and two longer (1.56 Å) P-O bond lengths. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Er and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Er, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent Na, one Er, and one P atom. F is bonded to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Er atoms to form edge-sharing FNa₂Er₂ tetrahedra.
